title: gen z analog gifts christmas holidays (Fortune)
claim: Citing PwC's 2026 Holiday Outlook, 78% of Gen Z (versus 64% of all consumers) are interested in screen-free gifts this holiday season.
excerpt: Summary: 78% of Gen Z interested in screen-free gifts such as puzzles, art supplies and gift cards; 81% of 1,006 Gen Z respondents prioritize in-person holiday activities; 63% say a shared meal matters more than a present; Gen Z gift spending projected down 9% to $533 from $586.
